title: Canonical parity circuit bounds
statement: For every pair of natural numbers $n$ and $q$, the parity function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, given by the product of all $n$ coordinates, has a depth circuit of depth exactly $q+3$, size at most $(q+2)\\,b^{q+1}2^b$, and width at most $n$, where $b=\\max\\{1,\\lceil n^{1/(q+2)}\\rceil\\}$.
